id: 11_MOOC INTRODUCTION TO BIORISK MANAGEMENT COVID19 DIAGNOSTICS
title: 呼吸道病毒样本的核酸检测（国内版）
source_doc: course/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/11_MOOC INTRODUCTION TO BIORISK MANAGEMENT COVID19 DIAGNOSTICS.md
author_source: project/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/11_MOOC INTRODUCTION TO BIORISK MANAGEMENT COVID19 DIAGNOSTICS（国内版）/src.py

points.S1: 培养病毒和做检测，级别不同
points.S2: 阳性结果：报告与样本处置
points.S3: 大批量检测，轮班防疲劳

shots.scene: 欣欣站在核酸检测实验室门口，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the door of a nucleic acid testing laboratory and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天聊聊：呼吸道病毒样本怎么检测。
overlay: 呼吸道病毒样本的核酸检测

shots.scene: 欣欣身后一个日历图标翻回过去的年份
shots.prompt_en: Behind the panda mascot, a calendar icon flips back to an earlier year.
shots.narration: 原片拍于疫情期间，有些是当时做法。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在一大批样本盒前，表情紧张
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands in front of a large stack of sample boxes, looking nervous.
shots.narration: 阿杰被派去帮忙做核酸检测。

shots.scene: 阿杰翻着空白笔记本，满是问号
shots.prompt_en: The young male student flips through a blank notebook covered with question mark icons.
shots.narration: 样本这么多，先干什么，后干什么？

shots.scene: 小研拿着空白流程卡走过来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over holding a blank flowchart card.
shots.narration: 小研说：照着流程，一步一步来。

shots.scene: 流程卡展开：样本管、柜子、加热模块、提取管、PCR 仪五个图标
shots.prompt_en: The flowchart card unfolds into five icons: a sample tube, a safety cabinet, a heating block, extraction tubes and a thermal cycler. No people.
shots.narration: 这一课，从样本进门讲到出结果。

shots.scene: 一支拭子插在装有保存液的小管里
shots.prompt_en: A swab sitting in a small tube of transport medium liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 最常见的是鼻咽拭子，泡在保存液里。

shots.scene: 一排图标：血清管、血管、粪便盒、尿杯
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a serum tube, a blood tube, a stool container and a urine cup. No people.
shots.narration: 也可能是血清、血液、粪便、尿液。

shots.scene: 每个样本都配着对应的保存管
shots.prompt_en: Each sample icon paired with its own matching storage tube. No people.
shots.narration: 送来时，都装在合适的保存介质里。

shots.scene: 小研在电脑前录入，屏幕空白表格
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student enters sample records on a computer showing a blank table.
shots.narration: 样本到了，第一步是编目登记。

shots.scene: 小研和电话另一头的医院图标核对清单
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks a blank list while on the phone with a hospital icon on the other end.
shots.narration: 和送样的医院一起核对清单。

shots.scene: 病人头像图标变成一串编码条码
shots.prompt_en: A patient silhouette icon turning into a coded barcode label on a tube. No people.
shots.narration: 每份样本编一个号，

shots.scene: 姓名卡上一把锁
shots.prompt_en: A blank name card locked under a padlock. No people.
shots.narration: 病人的身份信息，锁起来保护好。

shots.scene: 小研把样本架放进生物安全柜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student places a sample rack inside a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 开样本管，必须在生物安全柜里。

shots.scene: 在普通台面上开管的图标，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a sample tube being opened on an open bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 病人样本，不能在台面上开。

shots.scene: 柜旁挂着一本空白操作规程
shots.prompt_en: A blank standard operating procedure binder hanging beside the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 每一步，都照操作规程做。

shots.scene: 柜内，样本管插进加热模块
shots.prompt_en: Inside the cabinet, sample tubes are seated in a heating block. No people.
shots.narration: 开管后，先灭活。

shots.scene: 温度计图标加计时器图标
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon next to a timer icon. No people.
shots.narration: 加热到规定温度，保持规定时间。

shots.scene: 规程书上一个日历标记，旁边写着当时做法的图示
shots.prompt_en: A blank procedure book stamped with an old calendar icon. No people.
shots.narration: 原片的条件，是当时做法，

shots.scene: 新版规程书盖上对勾
shots.prompt_en: A newer blank procedure book receiving a green check stamp. No people.
shots.narration: 以现行规定和试剂说明书为准。

shots.scene: 病毒图标从活跃变成灰色
shots.prompt_en: A virus icon fading from bright to grey and inactive. No people.
shots.narration: 灭活后，病毒失去感染力，再往下做。

shots.scene: RNA 单链图标
shots.prompt_en: A single-stranded RNA icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这类病毒的遗传物质是RNA。

shots.scene: 小研在柜内用空白提取试剂盒操作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student uses a plain blank extraction kit inside the biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 所以用RNA提取试剂盒来提取。

shots.scene: RNA 图标在室温下碎成几段
shots.prompt_en: An RNA strand icon breaking into pieces at room temperature. No people.
shots.narration: RNA很不稳定，放久了就降解。

shots.scene: 提取好的管子立刻插进冰盒
shots.prompt_en: Freshly extracted tubes placed straight into an ice box. No people.
shots.narration: 提取完，马上放到冰上。

shots.scene: 日历和时钟图标，箭头直接指向提取
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon with a short arrow straight from sample arrival to extraction. No people.
shots.narration: 样本到了，最好尽快处理。

shots.scene: 一台实时荧光 PCR 仪，机身空白
shots.prompt_en: A real-time thermal cycler with a plain blank casing. No people.
shots.narration: 接下来，上荧光定量PCR仪。

shots.scene: RNA 单链经过一把剪刀状的酶图标变成 DNA 双链
shots.prompt_en: An RNA strand passing through an enzyme icon and turning into a double-stranded DNA. No people.
shots.narration: 先用逆转录酶，把RNA变成cDNA，

shots.scene: 屏幕上一条上升的曲线，无文字
shots.prompt_en: A screen showing a rising amplification curve, no text. No people.
shots.narration: 再一边扩增，一边读荧光。

shots.scene: 病毒基因组长条，上面三段被高亮
shots.prompt_en: A long viral genome bar with three short segments highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 引物专门对准几段关键基因，

shots.scene: 三对小箭头分别夹住三段基因
shots.prompt_en: Three pairs of small arrows clamping each highlighted segment. No people.
shots.narration: 原片用了这三个靶基因。

shots.scene: 三根高低不同的柱子
shots.prompt_en: Three bars of different heights side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 不同基因，拷贝数可能不一样。

shots.scene: 小研看着屏幕上的三条曲线思考
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student studies three amplification curves on a screen with no text.
shots.narration: 判读结果时，要把这点考虑进去。

shots.scene: 三个大图标连成一排：加热模块、提取管、PCR 仪
shots.prompt_en: Three big icons in a row joined by arrows: a heating block, extraction tubes and a thermal cycler. No people.
shots.narration: 回顾：第一步，加热灭活；

shots.scene: 提取管图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: The extraction tube icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 第二步，提取RNA；

shots.scene: PCR 仪图标亮起
shots.prompt_en: The thermal cycler icon lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 第三步，逆转录加定量PCR。

shots.scene: 阿杰举手提问，小研点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand to ask a question while the female graduate student nods.
shots.narration: 哪一步没弄懂，就问。

shots.scene: 王老师在一旁听着，手里拿着空白记录本
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator listens nearby holding a blank notebook.
shots.narration: 不懂别硬做，问清楚再动手。

shots.section_title: 培养病毒和做检测，级别不同
shots.scene: 两扇门：左边普通二级实验室，右边更高级别实验室
shots.prompt_en: Two laboratory doors: one with a biosafety level two pictogram and one with a higher level pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 做检测和培养病毒，要求不一样。
overlay: 培养病毒和做检测，级别不同

shots.section_title: 培养病毒和做检测，级别不同
shots.scene: 培养瓶图标指向高级别门，旁边审批印章
shots.prompt_en: A culture flask icon pointing to the higher-level door with an approval stamp beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 培养活病毒，风险高，须经批准。

shots.section_title: 培养病毒和做检测，级别不同
shots.scene: 阿杰走向高级别门，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walking toward the higher-level door, crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 学生不得擅自开展。

shots.section_title: 培养病毒和做检测，级别不同
shots.scene: 王老师翻看空白的病原目录
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator reviews a blank pathogen catalogue book.
shots.narration: 具体级别，以现行病原目录为准。

shots.section_title: 阳性结果：报告与样本处置
shots.scene: 屏幕上一个阳性红点图标，小研立刻拿起电话
shots.prompt_en: A screen showing a red positive dot icon; the female graduate student picks up the phone at once.
shots.narration: 出现阳性结果，按规定及时报告。
overlay: 阳性结果：报告与样本处置

shots.section_title: 阳性结果：报告与样本处置
shots.scene: 阳性样本管放进单独的带锁冰箱
shots.prompt_en: The positive sample tube placed into a separate locked freezer. No people.
shots.narration: 阳性样本单独保存，按要求移交。

shots.section_title: 阳性结果：报告与样本处置
shots.scene: 检测后的样本和废物进高压灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: Used samples and waste going into an autoclave icon with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 用完的样本，按感染性废物处理。

shots.section_title: 阳性结果：报告与样本处置
shots.scene: 日历图标和规程书
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon beside a blank procedure book. No people.
shots.narration: 报告要求是当时做法，以现行规定为准。

shots.section_title: 大批量检测，轮班防疲劳
shots.scene: 一大堆样本盒和一个疲惫的人形图标
shots.prompt_en: A huge stack of sample boxes next to a tired, drooping person pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 样本多、时间长，人会累。
overlay: 大批量检测，轮班防疲劳

shots.section_title: 大批量检测，轮班防疲劳
shots.scene: 人累了，手边的管子被碰倒，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A tired hand knocking over a tube rack, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 一累就容易出错、出事故。

shots.section_title: 大批量检测，轮班防疲劳
shots.scene: 排班表图标，几个时段轮换
shots.prompt_en: A blank shift schedule icon with alternating time blocks. No people.
shots.narration: 要排好班，定时轮换。

shots.section_title: 大批量检测，轮班防疲劳
shots.scene: 阿杰脱下防护后在休息室喝水
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, out of protective clothing, drinks water in a rest room.
shots.narration: 出来休息，喝水，再进去。

shots.scene: 小研戴上防护口罩，双手按压鼻夹
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a protective respirator mask and presses the nose clip with both hands.
shots.narration: 接触呼吸道样本，要戴防护口罩。

shots.scene: 小研双手捂住口罩轻轻呼气检查
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student cups both hands over the mask and breathes out gently to check the seal.
shots.narration: 每次戴上，都检查一下密合。

shots.scene: 王老师帮阿杰做口罩适合性检验，戴着检测头罩
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator conducts a respirator fit test for the young male student wearing a test hood.
shots.narration: 首次选型，要做适合性检验。

shots.scene: 胡须和口罩边缘漏气的图标，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a mask edge leaking air over a beard, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 边缘漏气，口罩就白戴了。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现条码、生物安全柜、加热模块三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three icons: a barcode, a biological safety cabinet and a heating block.
shots.narration: 编码登记，柜内开管，先灭活。

shots.scene: 提取管放冰盒、PCR 仪、三根柱子
shots.prompt_en: Icons of tubes in an ice box, a thermal cycler and three bars of different heights. No people.
shots.narration: 提完上冰，逆转录扩增，留意拷贝数。

shots.scene: 两扇实验室门、电话、排班表、口罩图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of two laboratory doors, a phone, a shift schedule and a respirator mask. No people.
shots.narration: 分清级别，及时报告，轮班，戴严口罩。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一个冰盒，向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up an ice box of sample tubes and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 规范检测，护己护人，我们下次见！
